title: Gym-Ready HealthSim: A PyTorch–SimPy Pattern for RL-in-the-Loop Operations Science
content: This paper presents a reproducible integration pattern that couples deep reinforcement learning agents built in PyTorch with discrete-event simulations in SimPy, exposing a minimal reset/step/render contract to support experiment design, ablation, and benchmarking across environments. The framework formalizes environment state vectors, reward shaping, action legality, and episodic training loops to enable data-science workflows such as policy evaluation, sample-efficiency analysis, and hyperparameter sweeps under consistent interface guarantees. As a reference case, an acute-care capacity simulation is instrumented to compare Double DQN and Dueling Double DQN variants (including noisy layers, prioritized replay, bootstrapping/ bagging), reporting learning trajectories and policy stability rather than task-specific KPIs. The design emphasizes portable experiment code, clear separation of data collection from learning logic, and compatibility with Gym-style agents to accelerate reproducibility and cross-study comparisons. Beyond the exemplar, the pattern generalizes to other stochastic service systems, providing a data-science scaffold for safe reward exploration and pre-training before transfer to real-world operations.
